[@Naglfae] look at the forum

Goal
* Consider changing the two instances of "->" to "→".

Input
* Line 1: Please change "length of spun words" to "word length for spinning".

* Line 2: Please change "amount" to "number".

* Next n lines: Please change "sentence [[sen]]" to "string [[sen]] for a sentence to transform."

Output
* Please change the description as:
The resulting sentence after applying the word transformation rules.

Constraints
* Please change 20 to 10 as [[n]] never exceeds 10.

* Please add: 1 <= length of [[sen]] <= 100.

Stub generator
* Please change 1000 to 100.

Game modes
* It might be too difficult to guess the task in Reverse mode. Consider disabling it.

Cases
* Please swap "Some spun" (Test/Validator 2) with "No spin" (Test/Validator 1), as "Some spun" is a more representative case and serves as a better example.

* Please add a test:
  • x = 4, n = 5
  • One sentence contains "four o'clock".
  • One sentence starts with "It'll".
  • One sentence contains a 2-digit number followed by "MB" without a space in between.
  • One sentence contains a 4-digit number, and starts and ends with a single quote ' .
  • One sentence contains a hyphenated word.
  • One of the above sentences also ends with a 3-letter word followed by a punctuation mark.

* Please add a validator:
  • x = 5, n = 5
  • One sentence contains "g'night" and a 5-letter word.
  • One sentence starts with "You'll".
  • One sentence contains a 3-digit number followed by "GB" without a space in between.
  • One sentence contains a 5-digit number, and starts and ends with a single quote ' .
  • One sentence contains a hyphenated word.
  • One of the above sentences also ends with a 4-letter word followed by a punctuation mark.

Thanks.
